metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Wolfram Institute

plugins.name: computational-research
plugins.description: Wolfram-centric computational research: organize projects and sources, maintain a wiki, create and edit notebooks, collaborate on human-owned papers and paclet designs through concise notes companions, develop and publish paclets, retrieve citations, formalize requested proofs, and manage a backlog with isolated workers. Preserves human edits and author-controlled iterations; publication requires an explicit request. README.md is the authoritative workflow blueprint.
